get.summary: Reports whether the API and its dependencies are healthy.
Lists the expenses of one month (year, month) or of a period (from, to, both included), newest first, with their total.

post.summary: Adds an expense. Send a new Idempotency-Key per entry; a repeat returns the first id.

put.summary: Changes an expense. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

get.summary: Lists the expense categories in display order.
Lists one month's incomes, newest first, with the month's total.

post.summary: Adds an income. Send a new Idempotency-Key per entry; a repeat returns the first id.

put.summary: Changes an income. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

get.summary: Lists one month's savings movements, newest first, with the month's sums and balances.

post.summary: Adds a savings movement. Send a new Idempotency-Key per entry; a repeat returns the first id.

get.summary: The current savings balance and every month's deposits, withdrawals and closing balance.

put.summary: Changes a savings movement. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

delete.summary: Deletes a savings movement for good.

get.summary: The budget settings (monthly limit, savings goal) and every spending limit, in order.
One month at a glance: incomes, expenses, the month's result, the savings jar, limits and top categories.

put.summary: Sets the monthly limit on all expenses and the savings goal. Send the budget version in If-Match.

post.summary: Adds a spending limit at the end of the list. Send a new Idempotency-Key per limit.

put.summary: Changes a spending limit. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

delete.summary: Deletes a spending limit for good; its expenses stay.

get.summary: Lists the wanted gifts (archived=false, by priority, then the nearest occasion) or the archive of gifted and dropped ones (archived=true, latest gifted first), with their variants.

post.summary: Adds a wanted gift with its variants. Send a new Idempotency-Key per gift; a repeat returns the first id.

put.summary: Changes a gift and replaces its whole variant list; the status stays. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

delete.summary: Deletes a gift and its variants for good.

put.summary: Marks a gift Gifted (with giftedOn, today in Kyiv by default) or Dropped, which moves it to the archive, or Wanted, which returns it to the list. Send its version in If-Match.

get.summary: The wishlist for the home page: per recipient and in total the wanted and gifted counts and sums, the top High-priority wanted gifts, the upcoming occasions and all details.
Lists the gift categories in display order.

post.summary: Adds a gift category at the end of the list. Send a new Idempotency-Key; 409 when the name is taken.

put.summary: Renames a gift category; its gifts follow. 409 when the name is taken.

delete.summary: Deletes a gift category; 409 while any gift (also an archived one) uses it.

get.summary: Lists the personal details (sizes and other nuances) by recipient (Maria, Vitaliy, Together) and position.

post.summary: Adds a detail at the end of the recipient's list. Send a new Idempotency-Key; a repeat returns the first id.

put.summary: Changes a detail; its position stays. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

get.summary: Lists the active tasks (view=active, by priority, due date, creation) or the archive (view=archive, newest completion first). assignee may repeat.

post.summary: Adds a task with its first steps. Send a new Idempotency-Key per task; a repeat returns the first id.

get.summary: Returns one task with its steps, active or archived.

put.summary: Changes a task, status included. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

delete.summary: Deletes a task and its steps for good. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

put.summary: Moves a task to another status, also out of the archive. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when someone changed it meanwhile.

post.summary: Adds a step at the end of a task's checklist (at most 50). Needs no If-Match.

put.summary: Renames a step and ticks or unticks it. Needs no If-Match.

delete.summary: Removes a step from a task's checklist. Needs no If-Match.

get.summary: Lists the to-do categories in display order, with how many active tasks each holds.

post.summary: Adds a category at the end of the list. 409 when the name (any case) is taken.

put.summary: Renames a category and changes its emoji. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when changed meanwhile or the name is taken.

delete.summary: Deletes a category; its tasks stay, without a category. Send its version in If-Match; 409 when changed meanwhile.

get.summary: The home page block: per assignee the active, overdue and due-today counts, tasks done in 7 days, and up to 8 tasks to look at first. Today is the date in Kyiv.

Assignee.description: Whose task it is (the sheet's «Чьё» column): one of the two people or both of them.

AssigneeCounts.description: How many active tasks an assignee has, how many of them are overdue and how many are due today.

BudgetView.description: The monthly limit on all expenses (0 = none), the savings goal (0 = none) and the category limits.

CategoryAmount.description: How much went to one category in the month.

CategoryItem.description: A category as lists and pickers show it.

CreatedEntry.description: The id of a created expense, income or savings movement.

CreatedGiftsEntry.description: The id of a created gift, category or detail.

ExpenseItem.description: One expense row of the month list, with its category name.

ExpenseList.description: One page of a month's or a period's expenses, plus the sum of every expense that matches the filter (not just this page).

GiftCategoryItem.description: A gift category as lists and pickers show it.

GiftCounts.description:
The figures of one recipient or of everyone. Sums count only the gifts with a known price; dropped gifts count
nowhere.

GiftDetailItem.description: A detail («нюанс») as settings and the home summary show it.

GiftItem.description: A gift as the list shows it, with its category name and its variants in order.

GiftsSummary.description:
The home page's view of the wishlist: every recipient (Маша, Виталий, Вместе, always all three, in that order), the
total, up to five upcoming occasions, and all details. Computed on every read.

GiftStatus.description:
Where a gift idea stands. GiftStatus.Wanted is the active list; GiftStatus.Gifted (given or bought, the sheet's
«Куплено») and GiftStatus.Dropped («Не актуально») are the archive.

GiftVariantItem.description: One variant of a gift: a link with an optional title and price.

IncomeItem.description: One income row of the month list.

IncomeList.description: One page of a month's incomes, plus the sum of every income that matches the filter.

LimitPeriod.description: The stretch of time a spending limit covers: a calendar month or a calendar quarter.

from.description: The first day of the limit's period.

to.description: The last day of the limit's period.

left.description: The limit minus what was spent; negative when it is overspent.

percent.description: Spent as a share of the limit, in percent, rounded.

perDay.description: What may still be spent per day until the period ends, or null when the period is not running now.

LimitUsage.description: A spending limit against what was spent in its month or quarter (the quarter that holds the summary's month).

monthlyLimit.description: The limit on all expenses of a month; 0 means none.

daysLeft.description: Days left in the month counting today, or null when the month is not the current one.

result.description: Incomes minus expenses minus what was put into the jar (plus what was taken out).

savingsNet.description: Put into the jar minus taken out during the month.

savingsBalance.description: What the jar held at the end of the month.

savingsGoal.description: How much the jar should hold; 0 means no goal.

MonthSummary.description:
One month at a glance, like the old «Сводка» sheet without its plan block: incomes and expenses with who they
belong to, the month's result after the savings jar, the jar itself, the spending limits and the top categories.

Payer.description:
Who an expense is booked to (the sheet's «Кто» column): one of the two people, or the household as a whole for
shared spending such as groceries.

PayerAmount.description: How much one payer (Виталий, Мария or the shared budget) spent in the month.

PaymentMethod.description: How an expense was paid (the sheet's «Оплата» column).

Person.description: One of the two people the household accounts belong to. Incomes always belong to one of them.

PersonAmount.description: How much one person earned in the month.

Priority.description: How much the recipient wants it: «🔥 Очень хочу», «⭐ Хочу», «💭 Когда-нибудь».

Recipient.description: Whom a gift or a detail is for: Маша, Виталий, or both («Вместе», things for the home).

RecipientSummary.description: One recipient's figures and up to five of their High-priority wanted gifts, in the active list's order.

SavingsDirection.description: Whether a savings movement put money in or took it out; shown in blue and red on the page.

SavingsMonthSummary.description: One month of the jar: put in, taken out (positive) and the balance at the month's end.

SavingsMovementItem.description: One movement of the savings jar; decimal SavingsMovementItem.Amount is signed (plus in, minus out).

SavingsMovementList.description:
One page of a month's savings movements, with the month's sums (decimal SavingsMovementList.Withdrawals as a positive number),
the balance before and after the month, and the jar's balance today.

SavingsOverview.description: The jar's balance today and its movement month by month, newest month first.

SpendingLimitItem.description: One spending limit with the categories it counts.

SummaryGift.description: A wanted «🔥» gift in a recipient's top list.

SystemStatus.description: The overall status, the build version with its commit, the environment, and the status of each check.

TaskStepItem.description: One step of a task's checklist.

TodoCategoryItem.description: A category with its version for `If-Match` and how many active tasks it holds.

TodoCreated.description: The id of a created task, step or category.

TodoPriority.description: How soon a task matters. Stored as text; lists rank it Urgent first, Low last.

TodoStatus.description:
Where a task stands. TodoStatus.Todo, TodoStatus.InProgress and TodoStatus.Paused are active;
TodoStatus.Done and TodoStatus.Cancelled are archived.

TodoSummary.description:
The home page block: today's date in Kyiv, the counts of Маша, Виталий and Общее (always all three, in that
order), how many tasks were done in the last seven days, and up to eight tasks to look at first.

TodoTaskItem.description:
A task as lists show it, with its category, its steps in order and its version for `If-Match`. Lists carry
notes and steps too, so opening a task needs no second request.

TodoTaskList.description: One page of active or archived tasks and how many match the filter in all.

UpcomingOccasion.description: A wanted gift whose occasion is today or later.
